text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training with Mihono Bourbon.
Normally, she finishes her preparations
well before the scheduled time, but—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...1 minute until training commencement time.
Apologies for the wait, Master."
choice_data_list: It's rare to see you cut it so close
It's rare to see you cut it so close, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. Actually—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Found it!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-san!
We're not done talking yet!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. However, it is already time for training to begin.
I cannot discuss this any further.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's right! The agenda is:
"Why do people break vending machines?"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As the Class Rep, I cannot allow the academy's property to be destroyed!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I touch machinery, it malfunctions without exception.
Cause unknown. There is no malicious intent.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I understand it wasn't intentional!
However, the cause is still up for debate—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O spreads her arms wide, determined not to let Mihono Bourbon escape.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, to break machines just by touching them is quite a mysterious constitution.
Investigating the cause may be important, but—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As an immediate problem,
not being able to use the vending machine is a huge pain.
We might need to take some kind of measure.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Are you listening, Bourbon-san!
Your Trainer needs to participate
in discussions properly as well—"
choice_data_list: It's a real problem that the vending machine is out of order.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Mmh? Well, that is true, yes.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Master.
I recognize that to be extremely "inconvenient."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Refilling water bottles, buying at the school store—when neither is an option, the vending machine becomes essential.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yet I... simply cannot do that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As I thought, leaving things like this is a problem.
It's fine when I'm nearby, but when I'm not—"
choice_data_list: Let's ask a friend who's nearby.
Like using a tool to buy them or something

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Friends...
I judge that to be difficult.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
For one thing, I have almost no one
I can truly call a 'friend.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Second, there's no guarantee your few "friends"
will be nearby—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Then all you need to do is call me!
I shall rush over at full Bakushin, anytime, anywhere!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"As the Class Representative, I can't just ignore a student in trouble!
Besides, we're friends!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Were you two friends?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's right!! Having me, the Class Rep, as your friend is something you ought to boast about!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, not especially.
...Though, yes... friends...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... I know you're happy, but please don't repeat it so much. It's making me blush.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood.
Whenever I use the vending machine, I will call for Bakushin O-san."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, leave it to me!!
To Sakura Bakushin O, the class president and role model for all students!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...
...Friends.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I began seeing Mihono Bourbon standing by the vending machine, looking just a little restless as she searched for her friend—Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Tools... something like tongs, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see!! You're quite sharp, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That way you can still put money in,
and you won't have to touch it directly!
Let's do that from now on!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I will follow Master's instructions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, just as Mihono Bourbon was about to use the vending machine with tongs—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What is it, what is it?
Bourbon-chan, why the tongs?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Are you buying juice, by any chance?
Then Falco will press the button for you~!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Bourbon-san.
You don't need to use the tongs.
I will push—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I'm sorry.
I can't reach the top shelf... Um,
could you please lift me up...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "—And after that as well, someone nearby was kind enough to help me."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
From these experiences, I determined that
asking for help would be more efficient
than using tongs.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Even someone like me with such poor
social skills... if I just ask for help,
someone will come to my aid.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...I think I will record this firmly
in my memory."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon just hadn't realized it,
but there were plenty of friends ready to help her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Relying on someone—
Mihono Bourbon had realized something truly important.
